result.rationale: save_host in the new Admin::EmbeddableHostsController calls params[:embeddable_host][:host] and [:category_id] directly; if the embeddable_host key is absent, params[:embeddable_host] is nil and the controller raises NoMethodError (500), and if host is nil the model's before_validation `self.host.sub!` also crashes — instead of the render_json_error 4xx path. Verifiable from the diff; a missing-payload guard is absent.

judged_text: save_host dereferences params[:embeddable_host][:host] and params[:embeddable_host][:category_id] with no presence guard, so a payload missing the embeddable_host key (or carrying host: null) crashes with NoMethodError — in the controller, or in the model's before_validation nil.sub! — instead of returning a 422. Any API or script caller hitting the new REST resource without a well-formed embeddable_host payload (the shipped UI always sends both keys) receives a 500 rather than the render_json_error 4xx that the invalid-host path promises.
